title: Participatory provenance as representational auditing for AI-mediated public consultation

bias_targets.methodology: Clustering participant responses using text embeddings to identify opinion groups, then calculating and comparing the exclusion rates and semantic coverage scores of clusters expressing dissent, critique, or skepticism versus those expressing mainstream policy alignment.

Estimating the causal effect of textual features—specifically response brevity (word count) and rhetorical register (assertive vs. hedged language)—on a participant's representational coverage score using doubly-robust Augmented Inverse Propensity Weighting (AIPW) and OLS regression.

Measuring the representational disadvantage of expressing minority or unusual opinions by using causal inference models to evaluate the effect of a response's semantic distance from its nearest cluster centroid on its coverage score.
